core.roles.title: Roles
core.roles.description: What each role lets its holders do. Roles are made and changed here; they are given to people in the console, with Give a role on Who holds what or on a person's page.
core.roles.owner-fixed: The Owner role brings every ability and cannot be changed.
core.roles.name: Name
core.roles.ends.label: When it ends
core.roles.ends.help: Every grant of the role ends this way, unless the person giving it chooses an earlier date.
core.roles.opens-members-help: Holders see the members' side as well as the audience side.
core.roles.abilities-help: An ability that comes with another is ticked with it. You can only give abilities you hold yourself.
core.roles.editor.comes-with: Comes with an ability already ticked
core.roles.editor.not-held: You do not hold this, so you cannot give it
core.roles.editor.off-hidden: Abilities of modules that are switched off are hidden: {modules}.
core.roles.editor.off-shown: Modules that are switched off are shown.

core.roles.ends.none-not-allowed: This theatre requires every role to end.
core.roles.templates.title: Start from
core.roles.templates.description: Begin with the usual abilities for a job, then change what you need.
core.roles.templates.label: Starting point
core.roles.templates.left-out.one: 1 of its abilities was left out, because its module is switched off or you do not hold it.
core.roles.templates.left-out.other: {count} of its abilities were left out, because their modules are switched off or you do not hold them.
core.roles.templates.producer.name: Producer
core.roles.templates.producer.descriptio: Runs a production: its details and performances, prices and complimentary tickets, and sees how it is selling.
core.roles.templates.box-office.name: Box office staff
core.roles.templates.box-office.descript: Sells, changes and releases tickets, takes payment, and admits people at the door.
core.roles.templates.front-of-house-mana: Runs the house on the night: the rota, duties, checklists, incidents and the night report.
core.roles.templates.bar.name: Bar staff
core.roles.templates.bar.description: Serves at the bar, takes payment, checks ages and keeps the stock counts.
core.roles.templates.treasurer.name: Treasurer
core.roles.templates.treasurer.descripti: Looks after the money: the ledger, closing periods, reconciling payments and approving refunds.
core.roles.archive-ends.one: The 1 grant of it that is live now ends at once.
core.roles.archive-ends.other: The {count} grants of it that are live now end at once.
core.facts.title: Facts
core.facts.description: Facts are things the platform knows about a person, such as leading tonight's shift. Whoever a fact names holds the abilities you map to it, while the fact holds. Each fact lists what it brings now; choose Change to tick or untick abilities.
core.facts.empty: No module declares a fact yet
core.facts.standing: Gives a standing: whoever it names sees the members' area.
core.facts.confirm: Whoever this fact names should hold the abilities marked Full control
core.facts.confirm-help: They count only once confirmed, because they give control over other people or the theatre.

core.roles.empty-help: A role is a set of abilities, such as running the box office, that you give to people for a time.
